description: Stop a recurring block from a date onward (the app's "Stop repeating"). Past days keep their blocks and the habit keeps its history; upcoming occurrences already created and not yet checked are removed. To skip a single day and keep the repetition, use delete_day_block on that day's block.

from_date.description: First day without the block (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

name: stop_recurring_block
